projects.title: Renewed Millennium
projects.description: One of the most renowned schools in the country asked us rebrand their identity reflecting their values, superb services and its reputation as the cradle of knowledge.

data.content: One of the most renowned schools in the country asked us rebrand their identity reflecting their values, superb services and its reputation as the cradle of knowledge.

We came up with an iconic logo that is built within a 12x13 grid of perfect squares that can be easily drawn by any student, representing the 12 years of schooling, the pre-school year, the growing ladder through knowledge visualized through the books, which also represent the roman number III.
We also designed a modern, colorful website that reflects the lively spirit of the school, yet orderly and efficient and full of valuable information.
